Unordered — default

  • Semantic HTML with token-driven spacing and typography applied via BEM utility classes
  • Each variant uses CSS custom properties scoped to the component, keeping overrides predictable
  • This item is intentionally long to show how wrapped text respects the list indentation — the second and subsequent lines stay indented under the bullet, not the container edge
  • Short item

Unordered — large

  • Larger body font with more generous row spacing
  • Well suited for feature lists, marketing copy, or scannable summaries
  • Wrapping still works: this sentence runs long enough to break onto a second line and the hanging indent holds the text away from the bullet marker

Ordered — default

  1. Install the package from the A1 design system registry
  2. Import the base stylesheet then layer a theme stylesheet on top
  3. Add class="a1-body" to the root element so tokens and resets apply
  4. Use semantic HTML elements paired with the relevant utility classes

Ordered — compact

  1. Compact reduces both font size and row gap
  2. Good for dense reference lists, changelogs, or metadata
  3. Text still wraps correctly while remaining tight and readable even across multiple lines of content
  4. Short item
  5. Another short item

Plain — no marker, no indent

  • No bullet, no left indent — useful for custom-styled lists or nav-like structures
  • Pairs well with icon prefixes or custom markers applied via CSS or inline elements
  • Wrapping content aligns flush to the container edge without any hanging indent

Nested — indentation

  • Top-level item
    • Nested item — inherits font size and line height from parent
    • A longer nested item that wraps to confirm the second level indentation holds and text does not escape back to the parent margin
    • Doubly nested
      • Third level — browser default markers shift to a circle
      • Indentation stacks predictably at each level
  • Sibling top-level item after the nested block
  • Another sibling with enough text to confirm the top-level gap and indent are unaffected by the nested content above
